products.name: Surya Rekha Sculptural Ring
products.tagline: Volcanic contours forged for everyday rebellion
products.material: Solid 92.5 Oxidised Brass Alloy with Antique Sterling Finish
products.finish: Deep Obsidian Black & Polished Ridge Accents
products.dimensions: Adjustable band (Fits standard Indian sizes 12 to 18)
products.care_instructions: Store in an airtight cloth pouch. Wipe clean with a soft dry cotton cloth after wear. Avoid direct perfumes and moisture.
products.story: Inspired by ancient solar iconography found on temple stonework, reinterpreted into a modern raw-edge ring. Made to be worn every single day without waiting for a festive calendar invite.
products.styling_tip: Stack with minimal bands or wear alone as a thumb statement piece with casual oversized linen shirts.

products.name: Dharini Architectural Drop Earrings
products.tagline: Intricate tribal filigree meeting bold geometric grace
products.material: Handcrafted Oxidised Silver Tone Metal with Ruby Glass Cabochons
products.finish: Antique Patina & Dark Red Ruby Inlays
products.dimensions: Length: 7.2 cm | Width: 3.4 cm | Weight: 18g (Balanced for all-day comfort)
products.care_instructions: Keep away from chlorinated water and lotions. Handle small bell chimes gently when storing in the signature cloth bag.
products.story: Challenging the notion that chandelier earrings belong strictly to bridal trousseaus. The Dharini drops are lightweight statement pieces engineered for high-impact styling from morning lectures to evening soirees.
products.styling_tip: Pair with an understated charcoal turtleneck or an unbuttoned dark khadi kurta.

products.name: Karan Tribal Engraved Cuff
products.tagline: Heirloom totems carved into contemporary armour
products.material: Dense Cast German Silver with Deep Acid Etching
products.finish: Matte Antique Smoked Silver with Carved Reliefs
products.dimensions: Internal Diameter: 6.2 cm (Malleable open cuff fits wrists 6.0 to 7.8 inches)
products.care_instructions: Gently squeeze or widen at the base to fit your wrist snugly. Clean occasionally with dry baking soda for natural lustre restoration.
products.story: A gender-inclusive adornment piece inspired by nomadic tribal wristwear of the Thar desert. Strong, tactile, and designed to age gracefully alongside your own story.
products.styling_tip: Looks commanding worn right above a wrist watch or on an otherwise bare arm with a rolled-up black sleeve.

products.name: Nirva Asymmetric Hasli Choker
products.tagline: A sweeping collar of sculptured silver and garnet accents
products.material: Structured Rigid Copper-Silver Alloy with Garnet Red Stones
products.dimensions: Inner Circumference: 38 cm | Collar Width: 2.2 cm at focal apex
products.care_instructions: Store flat in the provided case. Do not bend excessively at the central curve.
products.story: The traditional Indian hasli reimagined as modern sculptural architecture. By breaking symmetry and tapering the collar into an off-centre crescent, Nirva frames the collarbone with effortless drama.
products.styling_tip: Ideal with deep V-necks, bandhgala jackets, or layered with delicate oxidized chains.

products.name: Agni Prateek Stud Earrings
products.tagline: Geometric flame studs for subtle everyday intensity
products.material: Hypoallergenic Oxidised Metal with Sterling Silver Posts
products.care_instructions: Remove before showering and swimming. Store dry.
products.story: For those days when you crave the character of Indian adornment without the weight. Tiny sculptural fire-motifs that elevate the simplest jeans-and-tee routine.
products.styling_tip: Great as first or second ear piercings stacked together.

products.name: Viraat Oxidised Midi Rings Set
products.tagline: A quartet of tactile stackable bands and midi accents
products.material: Cast Metal with Hand-Stamped Tribal Runes
products.care_instructions: Wipe clean after daily wear. Avoid sanitizers directly on rings.
products.story: Designed for effortless self-expression. Spread them across multiple fingers or stack them on one for dramatic rhythm.
products.styling_tip: Wear across index and ring fingers on both hands.

hero.headline: Indian Adornment, Reimagined.
hero.subheadline: Challenging the idea that expressive Indian jewellery belongs only to weddings and special occasions. Handcrafted statement pieces, sculptural forms, and oxidised silver aesthetics created for everyday self-expression.

announcement.text: ✨ Free standard shipping across India on orders above ₹499 | Handcrafted oxidised collections

philosophy.quote: Jewellery is not just something you wear for an occasion. It is a way of expressing who you are.
philosophy.statement1_desc: We bring cultural inspiration together with contemporary fashion. Wear it to college, work, evening strolls, or quiet ordinary days.
philosophy.statement2_desc: Everyday luxury shouldn't cost a fortune. Our pieces are thoughtfully priced between ₹100 and ₹800 without compromising on tactile quality.
philosophy.statement3_desc: Bold sculptural forms, deep obsidian charcoal, dramatic oxidized silver, and hints of rich ruby burgundy.

founderStory.title: Why should people save the things they love for someday?
paragraphs: I grew up watching the most breathtaking Indian jewellery locked away inside heavy steel almirahs, brought out only twice a year for weddings or Diwali poojas. The rest of the year, we settled for mundane, lifeless accessories.
AROHVI began with a very clear, stubborn question: why can't we wear evocative, sculptural Indian adornment on a Tuesday afternoon? To college? To an art show? On a solitary coffee run?

AROHVI isn't a generic jewellery shop or an inaccessible bridal house. It is a sanctuary for people who treat personal style as an ongoing creative act. Each piece is designed to be lived in, experimented with, and cherished on the most ordinary of days.
Thank you for being here and adorning the unordinary with us.

policies.shipping: We ship all across India via reputed express couriers (Bluedart, Delhivery, DTDC). Standard dispatch within 24-48 business hours. Delivery takes 3-5 working days.
policies.returns: We offer a 7-day hassle-free replacement policy if your piece arrives damaged or with any transit issue. Simply WhatsApp or email our care team.
policies.careGuide: All AROHVI pieces are made with oxidised alloys. Keep away from harsh chemicals, perfumes, and water. Store in our signature cloth pouch.
